subject: Proposed buying milestones + procurement touchpoints for Novata
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@novatahealth.com>, Erik Townsend <erik.townsend@novatahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed buying milestones + procurement touchpoints for Novata

Lauren / Erik — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to align procurement, security, and economic decision milestones so we can get you to a pilot in Q3. Attached is a first-draft MAP workbook (Novata_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Key outcomes from the call:
- Economic buyer: Lauren Price (confirmed).
- Procurement owner: Cindy Park (introduced by Erik).
- Security review: Novata will run a vendor questionnaire and request a SOC 2 summary and data residency details.

Proposed milestones (high level) — please flag anything missing or off: 
1) 2026-06-18: Finalize MAP + sign off on success criteria (POC scope, latency/throughput targets). Owner: Novata econ/PM + Redwood AE.
2) 2026-06-25: Security questionnaire submission and SOC 2 one-pager shared. Owner: Redwood security + Novata security lead.
3) 2026-07-08: Procurement terms discussion (SLA, billing cadence, minimal SOW redlines). Owner: Cindy / Redwood legal.
4) 2026-07-15: Pilot kick-off (2–4 week POC). Owner: Novata eng + Redwood solutions.

Immediate asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm initials on the success criteria grid in the attached MAP by Friday 2026-06-18?
- Cindy — any special procurement gates (price approvals, compliance committees) we should surface now?
- Erik / Lauren — is SSO required for the pilot or will a test token suffice?

Attachments: Novata_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-one-pager.pdf (Redwood summary).

Thanks — I can hop on a short call Friday to walk through the MAP if helpful.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Erik Townsend <erik.townsend@novatahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Price <lauren.price@novatahealth.com>
Cc: Cindy Park <cindy.proc@novatahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed buying milestones + procurement touchpoints for Novata

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 9:12 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Lauren / Erik — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP)...

Thanks Markus — this layout is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement/security side: 
- Confirmed: Lauren is the economic approver.
- Procurement flow: I will route an initial vendor intake questionnaire to Cindy and procurement. Expect ~7–10 business day review once we submit, depends on legal redlines.
- Security: We will need a SOC 2 summary and a short runbook for data access during the pilot (SSO is preferred but for POC a scoped service account is acceptable). Can you also confirm data residency and whether logs/audit events are available?

Cindy — can you confirm whether Novata has an internal vendor risk committee review (monthly) or ad-hoc reviews? That will change our target for procurement sign-off.

Erik
Director of Integrations | Novata Health
erik.townsend@novatahealth.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Erik Townsend <erik.townsend@novatahealth.com>, Lauren Price <lauren.price@novatahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed buying milestones + procurement touchpoints for Novata

Thanks Erik — noted and appreciate the procurement timeline color. I've updated the MAP to reflect a 10-business-day procurement review window (see Novata_MAP_v1.xlsx, tab "Timeline"). Quick answers to your asks: 
- SOC 2: attaching the SOC2-one-pager.pdf that summarizes scope and controls. Full report can be provided under NDA if needed.
- Data residency: Hosted in us-west and us-east; we can restrict pilot traffic to us-west on request.
- Logs/audit: We expose request/response logs and token-level cost/latency traces via the Console; we can provide a short export during the pilot.

Action items I own: 
- Share vendor questionnaire response template by EOD Thursday (I will attach vendor-questionnaire.xlsx).
- Loop legal on a minimal SOW template for procurement redlines.

External ask: Lauren/Cindy — would a Tuesday 2026-06-15 10:00am PT call to align on the MAP and walk procurement items work for you? If not, propose two times and we will accommodate.

Regards,
Markus

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Novata MAP owners & next steps

Internal note (do not forward to customer) — tracking owners and deliverables so we can hit the proposed dates. Copying here into the thread for visibility.

Owners and commitments: 
- Markus: Finalize MAP and send questionnaire by 2026-06-11 (done).
- Sean (Solutions): Prepare pilot runbook (environment setup, expected token volumes, SLOs) by 2026-06-14.
- Monica (CS): Draft success criteria checklist and POC validation tests by 2026-06-16.
- Security (TBD): Prepare SOC2 artifact package (one-pager + NDA route) by 2026-06-18.
- Legal: Standby for SOW redlines; aim to provide minimal SOW by 2026-06-20.

Notes: We should proactively put an owner on post-pilot evaluation (cost/unit analysis) — Markus will own the follow-up with finance if pilot metrics look good. Also add HubSpot task for follow-up: https://app.hubspot.com/task/5920/follow-up-novata-map (linked in metadata).

Monica Patel
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
